scene.note: A clear view of a stream channel flowing through a wooded area with a corrugated drainage pipe in the foreground.

findings.question: channel_form
findings.evidence: downstream photo, center: the stream bed is shallow and wide with a flat bottom.

findings.question: bottom_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right side of channel: natural gravel and sediment bed visible through the shallow water.

findings.question: bank_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, along both banks: natural earth banks with roots and grass.

findings.question: habitats
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no distinct sand banks, stone deposits, or instream aquatic vegetation are present in the channel

findings.question: natural_debris
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no fallen trees, large branches, or leaf packs accumulating in the channel

findings.question: water_flow
findings.evidence: downstream photo, outlet: turbulent white water flowing rapidly out of the pipe.

findings.question: water_aspect
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right side of channel: water is clear enough to see the underlying bed.

findings.question: water_withdrawal
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no pumps, hoses, or intake structures are visible.

findings.question: barriers
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no transversal dams, weirs, or artificial sills crossing the channel.

findings.question: draining_pipes
findings.evidence: downstream photo, foreground: a corrugated pipe discharges water, but it cannot be confirmed whether the runoff is polluted.

findings.question: sewage_discharge
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no sewage solids, grey water, or sewage fungus visible in the stream.

findings.question: construction
